create_InferenceSettings_default: create an InferenceSettings object with default settings for general MLIP inference
create_InferenceSettings_turbo: create an InferenceSettings object with turbo settings optimized for long simulations with constant composition
create_InferenceSettings_traineval: create an InferenceSettings object with traineval settings matching training and evaluation defaults
use_UMATask_enum: use the UMATask enum to specify molecular tasks like omol, omat, odac, oc20, oc25, or omc
use_guess_inference_settings: use guess_inference_settings to resolve a string name or InferenceSettings object into the correct settings
